offering_description.value: Operates online sports betting, casino, poker and betting exchange brands for individual consumers, including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair and Sky Bet. It takes bets through websites and mobile apps and earns a margin on wagers or commissions on exchange trades.

primary_products.value: online sports betting; online casino games; online poker; betting exchange

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual adult consumers placing bets and playing casino and poker games online

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: gaming margin on sports bets and casino wagers placed by customers; commissions or management fees: commission on trades matched on betting exchanges
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns consumer betting and gaming brands sold directly to players; software / platform: proprietary betting and gaming platforms that take wagers from customers

geography_served.value: global: major operations in the United States, United Kingdom and Ireland, with further markets in Europe, Australia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: sports betting, casino, poker and betting exchange sold to the same online gambling customers

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps operated under its own brands; partners / resellers: affiliate marketing partners and sports sponsorship arrangements that drive customer sign-ups

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed gambling operator: US state gaming regulators, UK Gambling Commission and Irish gambling regulators

notes: Portfolio changes such as acquisitions and disposals may not be fully reflected in this description.
